name: NobodyNamed
description: Agent that looks up US baby name popularity, trend classification, and history from Social Security Administration birth records spanning 1880 to the present.

skills.name: Name history lookup
skills.description: Given a single US baby name, returns its trend classification (rising/stable/declining/endangered/extinct), peak year, peak birth count, and most recent birth count for each sex it was recorded under.

skills.name: Name prefix search
skills.description: Given a partial name, returns up to 10 matching names ordered by peak historical popularity.
